“Thru-the-wall eavesdropping on loudspeakers via rfid by capturing sub-

paper_level_summary_zh: 该论文在相关工作中引用[15]作为通过商用RFID设备实现穿墙窃听的典型例子，指出其论证了利用RFID进行穿墙窃听的可行性，从而引出保护RFID感知隐私的必要性。

evidences.evidence_quote: researchers have demonstrated the feasibility of using commodity RFID devices for through-wall eavesdropping [15, 17].
evidences.evidence_context: In addition, researchers have demonstrated the feasibility of using commodity RFID devices for through-wall eavesdropping [15, 17]. Thus, it is crucial to implement privacy measures to secure RFID sensing systems.
evidences.reference_entry: C. Wang, L. Xie, Y. Lin, W. Wang, Y. Chen, Y. Bu, K. Zhang, and S. Lu, "Thru-the-wall eavesdropping on loudspeakers via rfid by capturing sub-mm level vibration," Proc. of ACM IMWUT, 2021.
evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 正文[15]和[17]同时被引用，作为通过商用RFID设备实现穿墙窃听的可行性证据。但这里只是作为相关工作的列举，没有单独描述[15]的贡献，且属于普通相关引用，不适合作为强能力佐证。
